size_why: A full map and neutral overhaul (all camps replaced by nine Haunt creature types), two new district objectives, contested Soul Bags, a new Corrupted-item merchant tier, and six new heroes — the content moves where souls come from, not hero stats.
headline: The map economy is rebuilt from memorized farm routes into contested, discoverable soul sources — tempo arrives earlier and no two jungles read the same.

meta_thesis.previous: The lead engine was templated PvE income — guaranteed Tough Crate routes plus Sunken Plaza/Bell Tower hub fights — so AoE/sustain camp clearers and heavy-melee box farmers banked faster than lane bullies, with no comeback valve.
meta_thesis.new: The off-lane economy still wins games, but the fixed routes are gone: souls now come from behavior-varied Haunt camps, contested Soul Bags, permanent-stat Buff Containers, and earlier district objectives, so map knowledge and fast-clear kits bank faster than template memorizers.
meta_thesis.why: Drivers: all neutral camps replaced by nine Haunt types with new behaviors, Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza objectives, contested Soul Bags, and Buff Containers now rolling Move Speed plus Bullet/Spirit Resist. It extends 'map economy wins' but changes how and how early income is earned.

winners.why: Storm Cloud/Static Charge is the best clear for grouped, chasing Haunts and his crate-route opener now farms even faster (B->A).
Punch AoE farms the new camps fastest and Flying Strike paths open separated Shrines/objectives the new layout creates.
Green-lane roof/tree gives permanent lane high ground and districts/Steam Vents extend an already top-pick diver's routes; stays S.
Front-line gun tank with Weighted Bola anti-air in a patch that forces earlier fights — both the flyer tax and the frontline rise point at her.
Handed the default front-line slot with Baba still cut and Billy slipping; T3 bullet resist still commits under a Guardian despite the parry change.

losers.why: A single-target hook cannot punish crate/camp routing — the farm economy pays AoE, not pick combos.
Flyer tax is unchanged (air drag, Silver's Bola) and rising Lash is his worst lane — stays buried.
Late gun scaler in a no-comeback economy that now closes even faster; no item in his core moved.
Split-push scaler punished by contested Soul Bags and rising M&K/Lash — beaten by the meta, not the notes.
Flying burst scaler in a tempo patch, now hunted by buffed Deadman Danny (61% against her) and grounded by Bola.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The parry change is framed as a general objective tweak but is really a targeted nerf to the T3-bullet-resist objective-dive chain that Apollo and Mo & Krill relied on.
non_obvious_calls.why: Removing the cooldown reset on objective parries deletes the free parry chain only those resist-heavy divers used to sustain a Guardian dive.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Contested Soul Bags quietly nerf burst assassins who banked income on 'secure the kill, bank guaranteed.'
non_obvious_calls.why: Kill income now requires winning a second last-hit race on the bag, so secure-burst patterns convert less reliably.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Buff Containers are no longer just caster range stops — rolling Move Speed and Bullet/Spirit Resist makes them tank-contested pickups.
non_obvious_calls.why: Permanent defensive and mobility stats change who detours and why, raising the count of small skirmishes around pickups.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The Corrupted tier's value is inversely tied to how fast this patch ends games.
non_obvious_calls.why: It only activates around ~30 min, but Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza and contested income push fights and closures earlier, so many lobbies never reach the payoff.

uncertainties: Six new heroes are vote-gated, so their real meta impact is a rollout question, not a balance question — the first days are a lottery of who gets to play them.
Haunt camp soul values and clear difficulty are unstated, so 'which camps pay' is a live discovery rather than a given.
It is unclear whether the tempo shift actually closes games before The Broker's ~30-min window or just relocates the stall to the new hubs.
The win/pick snapshot conflicts with the KB in places (e.g., Graves 56.5%/48.5%), so some directional reads rest on contested data.
what_to_watch: Haunt camp soul values — which creature types are farm-worthy and which punish, and which kits clear them fastest.
First-contest timing at Bell Tower (bell broadcast) and Sunken Plaza (stamina strip) — the tells that hubs have moved earlier.
Soul Bag pickup rate — do fights genuinely extend to secure bounty, or does the bag get snaked and shift nothing.
Buff Container contest rate, especially Move Speed and Bullet Resist rolls, as the signal that pickups now matter to tanks.
New hero pick/win rates as the vote schedule rolls them out — plus whether a hotfix touches camp or crate economy.
